simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to חֲבֹל (H2258) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 4 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: חֲבֹל (chăbôl) means a pawn (as security for debt) First listed occurrence: Ezek 18 7.

definitions.full: H2258. chabol חֲבֹל noun [masculine] pledge (as binding ) — ח ׳יָשִׁיב Ezek 18:12 ; 33:15 ; as cognate accusative with חָבַל 18:16 . [ חֲבֹלָה ] noun feminine id. (on formation compare Lg BN 179 ) — חֲבֹלָתוֺ Ezek 18:7 .
